preconditions.description: The length of the palindrome string is between 1 and 1000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: The palindrome string consists only of lowercase English letters.
The input string is a palindrome.

postconditions.description: The length of the result string is the same as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in result)
postconditions.description: The result string consists only of lowercase English letters.
The result string is different from the input palindrome string.

postconditions.expression: not any(result > other for other in [palindrome] + [palindrome[:i] + c + palindrome[i+1:] for i in range(len(palindrome)) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'] if other != result)
postconditions.description: The result string is lexicographically the smallest possible string that isn't a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: result == '' or not any(result > other for other in [palindrome] + [palindrome[:i] + c + palindrome[i+1:] for i in range(len(palindrome)) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'] if other != result)
postconditions.description: If there is no way to replace a character to make the string not a palindrome, return an empty string.
